claims.statement: The PPWR requires producers to register in each member state where they first make packaging or packaged products available, and online platforms must obtain producer registration numbers and compliance self-certification.

Since 12 August 2026, foreign companies without a German branch that sell packaged products directly to German end users must appoint an authorized representative and record it in LUCID before market placement.
Germany's packaging register provides a machine-readable registration-status check, enabling evidence verification rather than relying solely on merchant screenshots.

contrary_evidence: German authorized representatives and EPR service firms can bundle dashboards, reporting, and system participation.
Marketplaces may build their own clearance workflows and expose only a simple registration-number field.

economics.acquisition_route: Embed a Germany-readiness check in two ecommerce agencies and one authorized-representative partner instead of selling merchants one by one
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 800 merchants at 9k PLN blended ARR yield 7.2M PLN recurring revenue and about 2.2M PLN EBITDA by year 5. At 3.5x EBITDA and 70% founder ownership, equity is about 5.4M PLN in years 5 to 7, provided channels keep CAC low and partner work stays pass-through.
economics.founder_time: 10 to 16 hours weekly once German partner operations are documented; country expansion is deferred until this flow is repeatable
economics.gross_margin_basis: Target 65% to 80% on software and evidence verification; statutory partner services are transparent pass-through or referral revenue
economics.payback: Keeping German listings active or avoiding a delayed market launch can repay a year of software for an established seller; validate suspension frequency
economics.pricing: 499 to 1,499 PLN monthly per merchant plus fixed partner-pass-through fees for representation and filings
economics.retention_or_repeat: Registration status, packaging quantities, SKUs, partner mandates, and marketplace evidence require ongoing updates

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A verified merchant-jurisdiction-SKU evidence graph plus rule-version and partner-resolution history
fingerprint.customer: Polish marketplace and web-shop merchants shipping packaged goods directly to German end users
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Allegro and Shopify agencies, ecommerce accountants, German authorized representatives, and fulfillment partners
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: SKU-to-jurisdiction EPR cockpit, verified status record, partner handoff, and marketplace evidence API
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The merchant pays at Germany onboarding and monthly for listing clearance, evidence refresh, and filing handoff
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A merchant enters Germany, adds a packaged SKU, changes packaging, or a marketplace requests current EPR evidence

founder_fit: A timely Polish-to-German wedge suits the founder's EU context, automation skills, capital ceiling, and low-camera distribution preference. Accounting and ecommerce agencies can aggregate merchants, while local legal representation remains with qualified partners.
risks: Incorrect producer-role mapping can lead to suspended listings or non-compliance.
A partner representative's service failure directly damages the product's reputation.
Multi-country expansion can become low-margin manual filing rather than software.

structure.control_point: The verified EPR clearance record required before a packaged SKU remains sellable in Germany
structure.critical_dependency: Qualified German representative partners and marketplace-accessible status evidence must be reliable enough for automated clearance

thesis: Create an EPR evidence cockpit for Polish marketplace merchants selling packaged goods directly to German end users, then expand one jurisdiction at a time. It would map SKUs and shipment packaging to the correct producer role, track LUCID registration and system-participation evidence, route mandatory authorized-representative work to a vetted German partner, verify current status, and provide an API-ready listing-clearance record to marketplaces and fulfillment firms. It does not itself act as the statutory representative unless separately authorized and qualified.
title: Marketplace Listing Clearance for Polish Sellers into Germany
uncertainties: Number of Polish merchants newly blocked or delayed by the August 2026 representative requirement.
Gross margin after required local-representative and system-participation partner fees.
Which marketplace and fulfillment APIs permit automated listing clearance and evidence refresh.
